name: Auth + RBAC/ownership
description: Adds session authentication plus role-based access control and per-record ownership checks on top of an existing stack pack.

inputs.name: sessionStrategy
inputs.description: How sessions are issued and verified.

inputs.name: roles
inputs.description: Comma-separated list of role names to seed.

setup.command: npm install iron-session bcrypt && npm install --save-dev @types/bcrypt
setup.description: Session sealing and password hashing for the sessionStrategy input; no framework generator exists for this, so the recipe is the dependency set plus the files asserted below.
Generates the role and ownership columns as a real migration rather than an ad-hoc schema edit, so the change is reversible and auditable.

requiredArtifacts.description: Session verification and role/ownership guard helpers.
Contains the migration adding role and ownership columns to existing tables.

verification.description: Authenticated, unauthenticated and cross-tenant access attempts are all exercised.

operationalEvidence.evidence: Every generated API route is wrapped in the ownership/role guard by default, and the test suite asserts a 403 on cross-tenant access.
